note: Shop settings for the website. Visitors in South Africa see report_price (rand) and use report_pay_link; visitors anywhere else see report_price_usd (US dollars) and use report_pay_link_usd (falls back to report_pay_link). Leave a pay link empty and the button opens an order email instead. Add broker referral partners to brokers and they appear on the scanner and stock pages.
report_delivery: Full report emailed to you within 24 hours of payment (PDF).
